injuries.longComment: Eboigbe hurt his ankle last Sunday against Houston and missed Thursday's practice. He was able to log limited sessions Friday and Saturday, however, to give himself a chance to play Monday. If Eboigbe can't give it a go, Nick Barrett could pick up many of his defensive snaps.
injuries.shortComment: Eboigbe (ankle) is questionable to suit up Monday against Baltimore.

injuries.longComment: Perryman has missed the entire season to date due to a pectoral injury. He was designated to return Nov. 4 and logged an LP/FP/FP practice progression this week. Perryman would have to be activated from IR in order to make his season debut Monday.
injuries.shortComment: Perryman (pectoral), who is on IR, is officially questionable to suit up against Baltimore on Monday.

injuries.longComment: It will be the second straight absence for Williamson after he hurt his calf in Week 8 against the Rams. His absence will be felt on special teams, where he has logged all of his snaps so far this season.
injuries.shortComment: Williamson (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's matchup against the Ravens.

injuries.longComment: James missed the Chargers' three games prior to the Week 7 bye due to a hamstring injury. He suffered a setback in his recovery during Week 8 prep, which will require a stint on IR for the veteran safety. James is required to be sidelined for at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 12 against the Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 29. Tony Jefferson will continue to operate in an elevated role in the secondary in James' absence.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed James (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.longComment: Waxter was hurt in the first quarter last Sunday against Houston and couldn't return to the contest. He was unable to practice at all this week and has thus been ruled out for Monday Night Football. Waxter has played in four games so far this season, logging eight tackles (seven solo) over 44 defensive snaps and 26 snaps on special teams.
injuries.shortComment: Waxter (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's battle against Baltimore.

injuries.longComment: doubtful
injuries.shortComment: doubtful

injuries.longComment: McConkey's next chance to play will thus arrive Nov. 22 against the Jets. In his absence versus Baltimore, Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris and KeAndre Lambert-Smith will be available to lead Los Angeles' WR corps.
injuries.shortComment: McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.

injuries.shortComment: McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.

injuries.shortComment: doubtful

injuries.longComment: Taylor sat out every Chargers practice this week, so it's not surprising that he's not going to be able to play Monday. The second-year offensive tackle has worked in a rotational role when healthy this season, so his absence will affect the Chargers' depth along the offensive line.
injuries.shortComment: Taylor (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's clash against the Ravens.

injuries.longComment: Slater underwent ankle surgery Thursday after suffering a high-ankle sprain during Sunday's loss to the Seahawks. The left tackle will now need to miss at least four games on IR before the Chargers can return him to the active roster. With Slater out, Logan Taylor will be protecting Justin Herbert's blindside in the Chargers' Week 5 matchup against the Broncos.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Slater (ankle) on injured reserve Friday.

injuries.shortComment: nfi-r

injuries.longComment: Awosika hasn't played since Week 2, when he suffered a leg injury against the Raiders. The 28-year-old managed a full practice Saturday following limited sessions Thursday and Friday, so he has a genuine chance of returning to action Monday. Awosika will likely return to a starting role at left guard if he's able to suit up.
injuries.shortComment: Awosika (fibula) is questionable for Monday's matchup against the Ravens.

injuries.longComment: Pipkins hasn't played since Week 1 due to a knee injury. He was placed on IR in late September and had his 21-day practice window opened this past Thursday. The Chargers will need to activate Pipkins from injured reserve in order for him to be eligible to suit up Monday.
injuries.shortComment: Pipkins (knee), who is on injured reserve, has been deemed questionable for Monday's matchup against the Ravens.

injuries.longComment: Penning entered the league's concussion protocol following the Chargers' Week 4 loss to the Seahawks. He'll be required to miss at least four games, so Week 10 against the Ravens on Monday, Nov. 16 is the earliest that Penning can return.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Penning (concussion) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.longComment: Biadasz's placement on injured reserve means the 2020 fourth-rounder will be sidelined for the entire 2026 season. He suffered multiple injuries to his left knee -- including his ACL -- during Tuesday's training camp practice. There was initial optimism that he would be available toward the tail end of the regular season, but Biadasz will now shift his focus toward being fully healthy for the 2027 campaign. Jake Slaughter figures to serve as the Chargers' starting center moving forward.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Biadasz (knee) on injured reserve Sunday.

injuries.longComment: Penning entered the league's concussion protocol following the Chargers' Week 4 loss to the Seahawks. He'll be required to miss at least four games, so Week 10 against the Ravens on Monday, Nov. 16 is the earliest that Penning can return.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Penning (concussion) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.longComment: Lance has been on the Chargers' injury report since late September due to a groin issue. He suited up for each of the Chargers' last two games, but it appears his injury has regressed enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. As such, Lance will be sidelined for at least four games, and the next time he can play is Week 10 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 16. DJ Uiagalelei will be the Chargers' backup to Justin Herbert while Lance is sidelined.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Lance (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

injuries.longComment: Njoku continues to progress in his recovery from fibula injury that landed him on injured reserve in late September. The veteran tight end turned eight targets into six catches for 67 yards across the first two games of the regular season prior to his injury, and his return would result in a reduced offensive workload for Oronde Gadsden.
injuries.shortComment: Njoku (fibula) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Ravens.

injuries.longComment: Per Noah Furtado of The Athletic, Ingold wasn't included on the Chargers' initial Week 6 injury report Wednesday before being a late addition on account of the shoulder issue. He'll be sidelined for at least the next four games, making him ineligible to play until Week 11 versus the Jets on Nov. 22. The fullback hadn't logged any carries and recorded three receptions for 35 yards on four targets through Los Angeles' first five games.
injuries.shortComment: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.
